subject: Coverage signal to action — ownership & short‑term mitigations
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Kline <sophie@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Coverage signal to action — ownership & short-term mitigations

Team —

Finance flagged a material coverage delta for Q4 on Acme (pipe-to-quota sits at ~2.1x vs. our 3.0x target). That gap puts us at risk of missing committed ARR if we don't tighten stage hygiene and lock in late-stage commits. I pulled the latest snapshot (attached) and sketched an immediate play:

Action asks (by owners, please):
- Owners update HubSpot stages + best-case/baseline ARR by EOD 10/29. (Ben: review all opportunities >$50k in the next 60 days)
- Naomi: quick gap-to-commit analysis — show where coverage shortfall is concentrated (geo/AE/industry) and call out reopen opportunities we can accelerate. Deliverable: short spreadsheet + 3 prioritized recovery levers. Due 10/30 noon.
- Karthik: coordinate standing follow-ups with Acme execs (pricing concessions, contract finalization blockers). Decide whether a formal MA P is needed.

I want a single page mutual action plan we can share with Acme by Friday if we need to compress close timing. Sophie — I cc'd you so we can surface any outstanding procurement or finance approvals on your side.

Attachment: Q4_pipeline_snapshot_20261028.xlsx (xlsx) — includes raw pipeline and stage rollups.

Short background: our target coverage for the segment is 3.0x because we expect a 32% attrition/forecast conversion rate across weighted stages. Right now the book shows concentration in mid-market opportunities stuck in Demo/Proposal.

Call to be blunt: I need precise stage hygiene updates, not estimates. If you have blockers that require leadership escalation (discounts, legal terms), flag them in your update and we will triage.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage signal to action — ownership & short-term mitigations

On Thu, Oct 28, 2026 at 9:15 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> Finance flagged a material coverage delta for Q4 on Acme ...

Quick update from AE side:
- Completed a stage scrub this morning. I pushed 6 opps from Demo -> Stalled (call required) and closed out 2 duplicates that were inflating coverage. Net effect: pipe drops ~ $120k (but cleans the funnel).
- 3 deals (total ARR $410k) are in Proposal with legal pending — I am scheduling a triage with legal for Monday 10/31.
- I will annotate HubSpot with best-case/baseline numbers and include an explicit close probability field for each >$50k opp by EOD.

Blockers: Acme procurement is asking for a single-year term and an SSO integration timeline commitment — those are delaying legal. I'm preparing a one-page concession matrix to propose limited term options.

Attachment: Acme_AE_updates_20261029.xlsx

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Kline <sophie@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T12:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage signal to action — ownership & short-term mitigations

Team —

As requested, here's a concise gap analysis (summary + attachments):

Snapshot highlights:
- Quota (segment): $1,200,000 ARR; current pipeline (weighted) ~ $2,520,000 => 2.1x coverage vs. 3.0x target.
- Concentration: 58% of the shortfall is in the Mid-Market cluster (deals $75k-$250k) currently split between Demo and Proposal stages.

Three prioritized recovery levers (estimated upside + effort):
1) Close acceleration on legal-blocked proposals — potential upside $410k but requires a legal/PO fast-track (low technical effort, medium legal effort). Owner: Ben.
2) Surface engaged but unscored POCs we can shorten via focused exec sponsor calls — potential upside $250k; needs 2 sponsor calls per week. Owner: Karthik.
3) Re-evaluate late-stage discounts: short-term price promotion with clear conditions (30-day opt-out) — potential upside $180k but requires finance sign-off. Owner: Marcus / Finance.

Deliverables attached: Acme_gap_analysis_20261030.xlsx, quick MA P draft (Acme_mutual_action_plan_draft.docx). I'm also linking the HubSpot view filter in related_links for easy review.

Recommendation: for immediate coverage, prioritize lever (1) + (2) this week while we work finance on (3). If Sophie can expedite procurement approvals on her side, that materially shortens the cycle.

-Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Kline <sophie@acme.com>, Acme Corp Finance <finance@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage signal to action — ownership & short-term mitigations

Thanks everyone — clear, actionable items. Finalizing owner roster and next steps: 

1) Ben — legal triage on the $410k in Proposal. Target: legal review slot Monday 10/31; push for redline turnaround in 48 hours. Update HubSpot with "legal-block" tag.
2) Karthik — schedule two exec sponsor calls with Acme for next week; confirm availability with Sophie today. Deliverable: one-pager sponsor agenda.
3) Naomi — consolidate gap sheet and publish a one-page recovery plan by 10/31 COB (include required finance approvals and expected uplift per lever).
4) Marcus/Finance — I'll open a short approval thread re: limited-time price concession (scope: up to 10% on specific late-stage deals) and will include expected ROI.

I'll own the mutual action plan finalization and external send. Sophie — once you confirm procurement timeline, we'll fold it into the MA P and propose a target close week.

I'll run a 20-minute standup tomorrow at 10:00 AM PT to confirm progress. If blockers escalate, call me directly.

Attachment: Acme_mutual_action_plan_draft.docx

Marcus
